content.text: HomeSportsBasketballNBANBA Regular SeasonCavaliers vs HawksTicketsFloor (Sections 1-22)OverviewTicketsScheduleTravel & ParkingAccommodationDestinationReviewsSales ClosedCavaliers vs Hawks has now closed sales.Save this event to your interests to be notified when sales open for future editions:Floor tickets (located in Sections 1-22) at the Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse get you as close to the action as you can possibly be for an unforgettable courtside experience – you'll be just feet from your favourite stars. What's more, all floor tickets provide access to one of the all-inclusive clubs at the Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse – either the Lexus Signature Lounge, Litehouse Chairman's Club, or Oswald Court Club – where you'll find food, beverages, and more. Your Package Includes Courtside Floor ticket in Sections 1-22 Access to either the Lexus Signature Lounge, Litehouse Chairman's Club, or Oswald Court Club (please check with the ticket supplier which lounge is included with their package) All-inclusive food All-inclusive beverages Post-game autograph opportunities Lexus Signature Lounge Seat in Sections 1, 2, 7, 8, 13, 14, 20, or 22 Lexus Signature Lounge has views of the players' locker room entrance and tunnel for behind-the-scenes experience Most exclusive club at Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse Upscale furniture and decor Chef stations (carvery and specialty options may include beef brisket stacks, smoked ribs, hot dogs, nachos, and desserts) Beer, wine, spirits, and soft drinks Flat-screen TVs Litehouse Chairman's Club Seat in Sections 1, 2, 13, 14, 20, or 21 Upscale furniture and decor Chef stations (carvery and specialty options may include prime rib, hot dogs, wings, salads, and desserts) Beer, wine, spirits, and soft drinks Flat-screen TVs Oswald Court Club Seat in Sections 1, 2, 6, 9, 13, 14, 19, 20, 21, or 22 Energetic, open social space with Biergarten atmosphere Buffet stations (carvery and specialty options may include corned beef, cabbage and noodles, hot dogs, salads, and desserts) Beer, wine, and soft drinks Flat-screen TVs Price OptionsKoobit is independent and any purchase you make will be directly with the seller.
